newsitem.title: USA: Jones Intercable to sell cable system.
newsitem.headline: Jones Intercable to sell cable system.

text.p: Jones Intercable Investors LP said Friday it agreed to sell its remaining cable television system serving Independence, Missouri to Jones Intercable Inc for $171.2 million.
Closing of the deal is expected to occur in the second half of 1997.
Net sales proceeds will be distributed to Class A unitholders, the company said.
The company estimates the return to unit holders will be about $16.12 per unit.
It noted that Jones Intercable Inc, a 19 percent unitholder in the company, will receive a distribution of about $25.7 million.
Jones Intercable Investors will pay Jones Group Ltd, a unit of Jones Intercable Inc, a $4.3 million brokerage fee in connection with the transaction.
